items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdkE1IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--300a8fb9814f600a3faacc3730f06189467d16a0/336614910_662596682253203_262226518326067549_n.png) #### In honor of Pride month, all proceeds from this competition (after expenses have been paid for) will be donated to [The Trevor Project.](https://www.thetrevorproject.org) #### All donations added alongside registration fees will be donated to The Trevor Project, but if you would like to make your own personal donation, [you can click the link here.](https://give.thetrevorproject.org/give/63307/#!/donation/checkout) * Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. * Competitors may only bring one guest maximum. **Competition Day Timing** - The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. - Lunch will end at the scheduled time. - Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called. ### Due to venue space, please try and limit your guest count to no more than one person (not including the competitor themselves.

items.name: CubingUSA Mid-Atlantic FMC Championship 2023
items.information: The only event being held at this competition is 3x3x3 Fewest Moves. For a more normal competition experience, check out [CubingUSA Mid-Atlantic Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MidAtlanticChampionship2023). Podiums and champions from this competition will be recognized during the awards ceremony at CubingUSA Mid-Atlantic Championship 2023. This competition will take place at different venues across the Mid-Atlantic region. Please see the Locations tab for more details.
